## Functions

### `projectComputeResultContract(result)`

Shallow publication metadata, distinct from the full job-result projection. The report marker states the native root category only. Large arrays of audio frames, glyphs or numeric reports retain their native contents and avoid an additional schema traversal. Output handle authority remains in _lookup().
